entities.summary: Akira Schmid is a Swiss professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the New Jersey Devils in the fifth round, 136th overall, in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
